support.faq_1_q: CAN I MODIFY MY ORDER AFTER IT'S BEEN PLACED?
support.faq_1_a: Orders can be modified within 1 hour of placement. Contact us immediately via WhatsApp.
support.faq_2_q: I ENTERED THE WRONG ADDRESS. HOW CAN I UPDATE IT?
support.faq_2_a: If your order hasn't shipped yet, contact us immediately and we'll update the address at no extra cost.
support.faq_3_q: HOW CAN I CANCEL MY ORDER?
support.faq_3_a: You can cancel within 2 hours of placing your order. After that, the order may already be in process.
support.faq_4_q: HOW DO I START A RETURN?
support.faq_4_a: Contact us within 30 days of receiving your order. Items must be unworn and in original condition with tags attached.
support.faq_5_q: HOW DO I KNOW MY ORDER IS CONFIRMED?
support.faq_5_a: You'll receive a confirmation email immediately after placing your order. Check your spam folder if you don't see it.
support.faq_6_q: WHEN WILL I RECEIVE MY ORDER?
support.faq_6_a: Standard shipping: 3–7 business days. Express shipping: 1–3 business days. You'll receive tracking info by email.
support.faq_7_a: Currently we ship within Mexico only. International shipping is coming soon — follow our Instagram for updates.
support.faq_8_q: MY TRACKING SAYS DELIVERED BUT I HAVEN'T RECEIVED IT. WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
support.faq_8_a: Wait 24 hours as carriers sometimes mark packages early. If after 48 hours it still hasn't arrived, contact us immediately.

shipping.processing_body: Orders are processed Monday–Friday and shipped within 3–7 business days, excluding weekends and major holidays. Once your order ships, you'll receive an email with tracking information.
shipping.processing_note: Cancellation and address modification requests for orders placed on Saturday–Sunday will not be accepted until the next business day.
shipping.payment_1: Credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express)
shipping.payment_5: Installments: 3, 6, 9 and 12 months interest-free with participating cards
shipping.return_1: You have up to 30 days from receiving your order to return items.
shipping.return_2: Items must be in new, unworn condition with original tags still attached.
shipping.return_3: Once your return is received, allow 5–10 business days for inspection.
shipping.return_4: After inspection, a refund to your original payment method will be processed.
shipping.return_6: Sale items can only be exchanged, not refunded.
shipping.return_7: We do not accept returns on items not purchased through viogi.com.
shipping.return_step_1: Contact our support team via WhatsApp or email.
shipping.return_step_2: You'll receive a prepaid shipping label.
shipping.return_step_3: Send the item in its original packaging.
shipping.return_step_4: Refund processed within 5–10 business days of receipt.
shipping.exchanges_body: The first exchange is free. Additional exchanges have a $99 MXN shipping cost. Contact us to initiate an exchange.

accessibility.title: ACCESSIBILITY
accessibility.commitment_body: At VIOGI, we are committed to making our website accessible to everyone, including people with disabilities. We continuously work to improve the user experience and apply relevant accessibility standards.
accessibility.standards_body: Our goal is to meet Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA.
accessibility.feature_keyboard_body: You can navigate the entire site using only your keyboard (Tab, Enter, Escape).
accessibility.feature_screen_reader_body: The site is compatible with screen readers such as NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
accessibility.feature_zoom_body: The site works correctly with zoom up to 200%.
accessibility.feedback_body: We value your feedback on the accessibility of our site. If you encounter accessibility barriers or have suggestions for improvement, please contact us:
